reviews.review:
Game concept is fantastic and I remember a bit from early access when the game first released. I'm a bit disappointed with how the game developed after early access. The game menus and tutorials are incredibly complicated. There is a career mode, but instead of you starting a small hotel and building as the game advertises, you are inheriting other hotels and having to do complicated scenarios that are ultimately just unnecessary  for the type of game this is.

There are also LOTS of bugs. Like, way too many that should have been resolved in early access. My game has crashed not less than three times in less than two hours. I have to constantly restart the game to continue playing. Also the tutorial is way too long, and too complicated. 

I do think the game is fun when playable, but the other aspects make it difficult to continue playing. It seems like developers over-complicated a simple and fun idea.
